insights.finding: Unemployed has the highest observed account default rate: 34.96% (251/718), versus 13.56% for Business Owner (250/1,844); gap 21.40 percentage points.
insights.so_what: Prioritize manual review and investigate affordability within this segment; association does not establish causation.

insights.finding: Under $30k has the highest observed account default rate: 38.67% (174/450), versus 9.52% for $100k+ (295/3,098); gap 29.14 percentage points.
insights.so_what: Review affordability and payment burden in this income band, using count and exposure alongside the observed default rate.

insights.finding: Mortgage has the highest observed account default rate: 24.65% (353/1,432), versus 13.88% for Auto Loan (393/2,832); gap 10.77 percentage points.
insights.so_what: Focus product-level monitoring on this segment and compare its risk concentration with its share of original lending.

insights.finding: South has the highest observed account default rate: 16.86% (607/3,600), versus 15.00% for Central (347/2,314); gap 1.87 percentage points.
insights.so_what: Investigate regional mix and underwriting differences before attributing the gap to location itself.

insights.finding: Among cross-segments with at least 100 accounts, Under $30k / Unemployed has the highest observed default rate: 44.30% (101/228).
insights.so_what: Use the combined segment to prioritize analyst review; validate on a later cohort before changing policy.
